mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that signals economic contraction, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.
